description: Needs sign-in (OAuth, scope watchlist:write). Adds a company from the Companies Daily database (by CIK or ticker) to the companies the reader follows, at most 50. When each edition closes, the reader gets one email with the new SEC filings of the followed companies. Use only when the reader asks for it.

cik.description: SEC CIK of the company (search_companies), leading zeros optional, e.g. "320193".

ticker.description: Ticker symbol, e.g. "AAPL" (used when cik is empty).

name: follow_company
title: Follow a company
